localizedValues.name: G1-Goldminer (Lower Site)
localizedValues.description: The group site has a covered shelter with sinks and access to hot and cold running water and picnic tables inside and out. Stay warm with two wood stoves inside the shelter and a communal fire pit outside with benches. Surrounded by a large field this site is very popular for youth groups, family and company gatherings and weddings. There is an underground sprinkler system in the site so the use of tent pegs longer than 6 in is not permitted. Large tent setup must be approved by Park Facility Operator. There is plenty of parking on the gravel, no parking allowed on the grass.
